test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding saturated and unsaturated carbon compounds is correct?

Statement I: Saturated carbon compounds are hydrocarbons where carbon atoms are connected by single covalent bonds.

Statement II: Unsaturated carbon compounds are hydrocarbons where carbon atoms are connected by single covalent bonds.

options.text: Neither statement I nor II is correct.
Both statements I and II are correct.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only statement I is correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saturated carbon compounds** are hydrocarbons where carbon atoms are connected by **single covalent bonds**.
 
• These compounds are typically **alkanes**.
 
• **Unsaturated carbon compounds** are hydrocarbons where carbon atoms are connected by **double or triple covalent bonds**.
 
• These compounds include **alkenes** (with double bonds) and **alkynes** (with triple bonds).
 
• Statement I correctly describes saturated carbon compounds.
 
• Statement II incorrectly describes unsaturated carbon compounds as having single covalent bonds, which is characteristic of saturated compounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Saturated hydrocarbons**__

 __
 
• These are **aliphatic hydrocarbons** like **methane, ethane, and propane**.
 
• They are generally **less reactive** than unsaturated hydrocarbons.
 
 
 
• **Unsaturated hydrocarbons**__
 
 
• These compounds include **ethene (ethylene)** and **ethyne (acetylene)**.
 
• They are more **reactive** due to the presence of multiple bonds.
